title: Profile
description: A profile and every record of it, api/profiles/<id>.json (section 4 of the text of the part).

format.description: The version of the part, the integer in export/VERSION.

owner.description: Whether this is the profile of the account's owner.

pseudonym.description: The pseudonym the owner made up for the learner, never a real name.

avatar.description: The code of a picture of app's set; empty when none was chosen.

age_stated_on.description: The day the age was given; absent on the owner's profile, which asks no age.

consent_age.description: The country's age of digital consent, 13 to 18, that the category was given by (consent-age calls it `applied`); absent where no age was given.

presentation_style.description: How the platform speaks and shows: today only the voicing, on or off, and its speed.

default_mode.description: The default mode of the screen of a task.

interface_language.description: The interface language, a BCP 47 tag; absent when none is set.

grade.description: The grade, 1 to 12, when a module asks for it.

ask_before_showing.description: A child's setting: the solution is shown by an action of an adult; always false at adult.

active_on.description: The date of the last learning request or adult action on the profile, by which an idle profile is deleted after 12 months.

items.description: The modules connected to the profile: one of them.

connected_modules.description: The modules connected to the profile.

items.description: The profile's lesson runs, open and ended: one of them.

lesson_runs.description: The profile's lesson runs, open and ended.

items.description: The profile's attempts, open and closed: one of them.

attempts.description: The profile's attempts, open and closed.

items.description: The engine's choices for the profile: one of them.

choices.description: The engine's choices for the profile.

items.description: The whole evidence log, in the order of seq: one of them.

evidence.description: The whole evidence log, in the order of seq.

state.description: The current state of the learner model.

items.description: Artefacts kept on the server; empty while storage is off: one of them.

artefacts.description: Artefacts kept on the server; empty while storage is off.

work_storage.description: Whether the storage of the profile's works on the server is on (R113).

items.description: A consent to the storage of works: one of them.

storage_consents.description: Each time the storage of works was switched on, by whom, by which version of storage-consent, and when it was switched off: the records live as long as the profile (R131; R136).

items.description: A report of a problem: one of them.

problem_reports.description: The reports of a problem with the tutor's words of the profile's attempts that api keeps: until the operator reviewed them, and for a year after (R123; R136).

items.description: The profile's quota counters: one of them.

connected_at.description: When the module was connected; no version is kept.

lesson.description: The lesson's full ID (lesson_id in the database).

module_version.description: The module's version, so the export reads without the index.

package_digest.description: The digest of the package the run goes on.

choice_id.description: The engine's lesson choice that opened the run.

begun_at.description: When the run began (started_at in the database).

last_action_at.description: The time of the last action on the run or its attempts.

end_reason.description: Why the run ended; absent while open.

ended_at.description: When it ended; absent while open.

lesson_run_id.description: The ID of the run of the lesson.

segment.description: The number of the segment of the lesson.

place.description: The number of the item in the task.

items.description: Why each submission of the item got no verdict: one of them.

unverdicted_reasons.description: Why each submission of the item got no verdict.

wrong_answers_before_first_verdict.description: The wrong answers before the submission that gave the first verdict.

final_verdict.description: The item's verdict at the end.

wrong_answers_before_first_correct.description: The wrong answers before the first correct one.

package_digest.description: The digest of the attempt's module package, sha256:<64 hex>.

module_version.description: The module's version X.Y.Z, so the export reads without the index.

module_format_version.description: The module format version the verdict repeats by, MAJOR.MINOR.

module_kit_version.description: The module-kit version the verdict repeats by.

task.description: The task's full ID; the database keeps the module ID and the local ID apart.

instance.description: The instance the seed chose, when the task is a template; the seed itself is not exported.

choice_id.description: The engine's task choice the attempt began by; one of choice_id, segment, previous_attempt_id.

segment.description: The task segment of a lesson run the attempt is, the segment's place from 1.

previous_attempt_id.description: The earlier attempt of the same task that this one began again from.

begun_at.description: When the attempt began (started_at in the database).

last_action_at.description: The time of the last action on the attempt.

close_reason.description: Why the attempt was closed; absent while it is open.

closed_at.description: When it was closed; absent while it is open.

wrong_answers.description: How many wrong answers the attempt has.

items.description: The technique IDs given at a solving step: one of them.

step_technique_ids.description: The technique IDs given at a solving step.

step_techniques_at.description: When the task's techniques were first given at a step.

items.description: The technique IDs given on request: one of them.

requested_technique_ids.description: The technique IDs given on request.

requested_leading_question.description: The leading question a hint asked for gave (format 0.4); absent when none was given.

items.description: The full IDs of the traps the program found in the attempt's wrong values: one of them.

traps.description: The full IDs of the traps the program found in the attempt's wrong values.

items.description: The hint ladder's rungs given, with their source: one of them.

rungs.description: The hint ladder's rungs given, with their source.

correct_answer_words_given.description: Whether the tutor's words after a correct answer were given.

items.description: Per item, the facts the evidence also carries; needed in the attempt for an attempt with no evidence: one of them.
Per item, the facts the evidence also carries; needed in the attempt for an attempt with no evidence.
Each submission with a verdict, in order: one of them.

submissions.description: Each submission with a verdict, in order.

items.description: On a task with a rubric, each submission in order; such an attempt has no ladder fields: one of them.

essay_submissions.description: On a task with a rubric, each submission in order; such an attempt has no ladder fields.

answer_slot.description: The place of the answer slot, the JSON of novatrail.observation.v1.AnswerSlotPlace by protobuf's JSON mapping with the names of the .proto fields.

reason.description: Why the answer slot could not be read.

items.description: The verdict of each answer slot: one of them.

answer_slots.description: The verdict of each answer slot.

answer_slot.description: The place of the answer slot, the JSON of novatrail.observation.v1.AnswerSlotPlace by protobuf's JSON mapping with the names of the .proto fields.

cause.description: The cause of the outcome, by its code.

number.description: The submission's place among the attempt's, from 1.

items.description: The verdict of every item and answer slot and what was read, as ItemVerdict/AnswerSlotVerdict hold them: one of them.
The verdict of every item and answer slot and what was read, as ItemVerdict/AnswerSlotVerdict hold them.

observation.description: The observation merged from the two readings; absent when only taps were sent.

items.description: The options tapped, beside the observation: one of them.

tapped_choices.description: The options tapped, beside the observation.

wrong_answers.description: The attempt's wrong answers including this submission.

outcome.description: What a call of AI came to when slots got unchecked by it (a Cause of the contract).

source.description: Whether its words came from the model or are the fallback text.

words.description: The rung's words; present only while the attempt is open, deleted at close.

explained_differently.description: Whether the learner asked to explain this rung differently.

explained_differently_source.description: The source of the other words, beside explained_differently.

items.description: Beside feedback, the mark of each criterion, by its number in the rubric (its index, from 1): one of them.

criterion_marks.description: Beside feedback, the mark of each criterion, by its number in the rubric (its index, from 1).

feedback_source.description: Beside feedback, whether the words were the model's or the phrase 'no feedback this time'.

package_digest.description: The digest of a package, sha256:<64 hex>.

engine_module.description: Whether the module is a module of the engine.

kind.description: What the choice gave; a choice of nothing is not stored.

chosen_at.description: When the choice was made, by which a replay restores the runs and closed attempts it saw.

task.description: The task's full ID, beside kind task; no version, the attempt takes the current one.

lesson.description: The lesson's full ID, beside kind lesson.

reason_code.description: The reason code, from the closed list ReasonCode.

engine_version.description: The version of engine that chose.

learner_model_version.description: The version of learner-model that computed the state.

items.description: The digests of every graph learner-model and the engine got, each marked whether it is an engine module, connected and suitable: one of them.

package_digests.description: The digests of every graph learner-model and the engine got, each marked whether it is an engine module, connected and suitable.

modules_release.description: The modules release pinned when the choice was made.

last_evidence_seq.description: The number of the last evidence of the log the choice was made by.

grade.description: The grade by which the model took the starting point of modules without evidence.

pool_without_ai.description: Whether the pool was limited to tasks checked without AI.

skill.description: The full ID of the skill chosen on the skill map; absent when the engine leads.

age_category.description: The profile's age category at the time of the choice.

seed.description: The engine's seed; empty while the engine takes no randomness, as now.

seq.description: The number in the profile's log, from 1.

attempt_id.description: The attempt the evidence is of; one per attempt.

package_digest.description: The digest of the attempt's package, by which wrong_key versions are filtered.

evidence.description: The evidence itself, as learner-model's message.

module_version.description: The version of the module whose graph the state was computed by; left out when the module has no current version and its evidence waits.

state.description: The state of the learner model, the fold of the log.

learner_model_version.description: The version of learner-model that computed it.

modules_release.description: The modules release of the cache's mark.

format_window.description: The window of module format versions of the cache's mark.

last_seq.description: The number of the last evidence counted.

items.description: For each module of the log, the version whose graph the state was computed by; module_version absent when the module has no current version and its evidence waits: one of them.

modules.description: For each module of the log, the version whose graph the state was computed by; module_version absent when the module has no current version and its evidence waits.

kind.description: What the artefact is: an essay, a drawing or a recording.

attempt_id.description: The attempt whose work it is.

voicing.description: The voicing: whether it is on, and its speed.

giver.description: Who switched it on: whoever consents for the learner.

withdrawn_at.description: When it was switched off; absent while it is on.

items.description: The version of storage-consent the person read: one of them.

texts.description: The version of storage-consent the person read; empty when it had no version in force.

attempt_id.description: The attempt whose tutor's words it is about.

reply.description: The answer that brought the words: a rung's, explain differently, after a correct answer, or the feedback of an essay.

rung.description: Beside a rung and explain differently: the rung.

words.description: The tutor's words as app showed them.

kind.description: The word of the closed set the person picked.

text.description: What the person wrote beside it; empty when nothing.

review_by.description: When the operator reviews it by: 3 days after it came.

reviewed_at.description: When the operator reviewed it; absent until then.
